svg.title: Harsh Bhanushali — Co-founder, DualMind Labs
svg.desc: Harsh Bhanushali — co-founder of DualMind Labs. “I build AI agents & automations — and the products around them.” CS student at Parul University in Vadodara, India. In 2025 I co-founded DualMind Labs with Rishi A. Bangoriya, and our first product — DualMind Arena, blind head-to-head AI model evaluation — is live. Open to work, worldwide: freelance, contract, full-time, internships · remote · NDA-friendly. Vadodara, Gujarat, India · IST (UTC+5:30). In this issue: No. 1 The Arena story · No. 2 Selected work · No. 3 Working together · No. 4 The toolbox · No. 5 Letters. Links to dualmindlab.tech.
